_about: Shared test cases for the field drop-down rule (2026-11-26). Used by backend/test_field_list.py (predict.distinct_saved_fields) AND frontend/scripts/test_field_picker.mjs (FieldPicker.jsx distinctFields), so both sides are checked against the SAME expected answers. Saves are newest first, like accounts.list_analyses.

cases.name: same outline saved under two names -> both shown
same name saved twice -> only the newest
names compared with spaces trimmed and case ignored
same outline saved twice at different times, different names -> both shown
old saves without a name: same outline still merged, different outlines kept
an unnamed save is not merged with a named save of the same outline
